item.title: Luger Ashley Farquharson claims another World Cup medal
item.description: The 26 year old won the first World Cup medal of her season last Saturday in the women’s singles competition at the Park City World Cup, finishing in third place. On Friday, she followed that up with the women’s singles silver medal at the Lake Placid World Cup. The post Luger Ashley Farquharson claims another World Cup medal appeared first on Park Record.
